tooling.message:
feat: site actions for check, deploy and preview, and the org's Renovate preset

## Intent

After the merges, the organisation should be consistent. No traces of edugo should remain, and only relevant issues should stay open. The story of the platform design should make clear what each repo is for, so that a person or an agent finds their way at once. Sites deployed separately should behave and look the same: shared design tokens and a shared header come as an npm package from the home page repo, referenced by git and kept current by Renovate.

## Key changes

- actions/site-check, site-deploy and site-preview hold the build, check, deploy and preview of every site, taken from the identical workflows of lernapps.github.io, apps and docs.
- default.json is the Renovate preset of every repo; it extends the owner's config, and our own building blocks (@lernapps/site, these actions) follow main without release age and merge when green.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same request: tooling (3a97735), lernapps.github.io (7f0df23, 888090c, c058c94, 1789f9b), apps (bc971c4, 6d5f8ce), docs (6941e78), app-templates (afaa590), .github (40c8ac7).

## Intent

After the merges, the organisation should be consistent. No traces of edugo should remain, and only relevant issues should stay open. The story of the platform design should make clear what each repo is for, so that a person or an agent finds their way at once. Sites deployed separately should behave and look the same: shared design tokens and a shared header come as an npm package from the home page repo, referenced by git and kept current by Renovate.

## Key changes

- Every page (index, vision, 404, the biz42 and pdt42 apps, the review pages) gets the header and footer with privacy notice and imprint; closes docs#7.

- npm run build and npm run check like every other site; the workflows call the site actions, the preview keeps its own review comment.
